about.text: A casein-based adhesive long established for labelling glass bottles: it holds the label through condensation and chilling, yet comes off cleanly in the hot caustic wash, so that returnable bottles can be cleaned and refilled.

facts.v: wet, cold glass: breweries, sparkling wine, soft drinks
holds against condensation and chilling, yet washes off in the hot caustic bottle washer
viscosity very sensitive to temperature, casein price swings; casein-free adhesives now compete
casein adhesive settled out of 2 % NaOH at 80 °C within 6 h and foamed more than a casein-free one (Henkel test)
